mapper.select: SELECT id, parent_id, ancestors, status FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0

WITH RECURSIVE department_tree AS ( SELECT id FROM sys_dept WHERE id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0 AND status = 0 UNION ALL SELECT child.id FROM sys_dept child INNER JOIN department_tree parent ON child.parent_id = parent.id WHERE child.deleted = 0 AND child.status = 0 ) SELECT id FROM department_tree

SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_dept WHERE parent_id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_post WHERE dept_id = #{deptId} AND deleted = 0) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_role_permission_dept WHERE dept_id = #{deptId})
